selector.rationale: Erythema Induratum best explains the painful lesions, bilateral lower extremity swelling, and discrete, round, dry ulcers with central eschars, supported by histopathological findings of mid- and deep dermal marked lymphohistiocytic infiltrate with neutrophils and focal abscess.

rejected.label: Polyarteritis Nodosa
rejected.why: While it shares some symptoms, the presence of specific findings like central eschars, dusky gray borders, and collarettes of scale, along with the histopathological features, more strongly support Erythema Induratum.
